prompt: Create a new task in the Mentor v1 project called 'Implement user notifications' with a rich text description that includes a heading, bullet list of requirements, and a link to task 1213506759986048. Assign it to me and set it due next Friday.
tests: Uses asana_create_task with project_id and html_notes (single-step creation)
Uses html_notes with <body> wrapper for rich text, written as compact single-line HTML

prompt: Find all incomplete tasks in the Mentor v1 project assigned to me and mark the oldest one as complete.
tests: Uses asana_search_tasks or asana_get_tasks with project filter
Filters for incomplete tasks assigned to current user
Calls asana_update_task with completed: true on the oldest task

prompt: Search for tasks related to 'authentication' and give me a status update on what's done and what's remaining.
tests: Uses asana_typeahead_search or asana_search_tasks to find matching tasks
Retrieves task details with opt_fields for completed status
Groups results into done vs remaining
Provides a summary without just dumping raw data
